description: Frozen inputs of the fwdlog lane (LEGACY_TRIAGE batch 3). sha256 of every file; a test recomputes them. A change is a new experiment, not an edit.

sources.sw_industry.parquet: PC .work/lab/main/sw_industry.parquet (identical to the server copy, 2658 main-board codes, 申万 level-2 with join dates), frozen 2026-11-17
sources.etf_amount_seed.csv: E074 Sina daily bars: sum of the 7 broad ETFs' amount per session up to 2026-11-09 (E089 baseline seed)
sources.event_links_v1.json: old event-links-v1 rule table (calendar event name -> 申万 level-2 industries), data not code
sources.ledger_entries.json: experiment ledger entries E053-E057, E059, E076, E077, E078, E087, E089 (specification of the ported experiments)
sources.prereg/*: pre-registration documents of the ported experiments

hash_rule: sha256 of the file bytes; for text files (md, json, csv) CRLF is normalised to LF first so a Windows checkout hashes the same
